explication: Moto is a Python library that intercepts AWS SDK calls or accepts AWS-shaped HTTP requests, then returns responses from in-process service mocks that maintain virtual AWS state. The principal workflow is test code → Moto interception → service request handling → backend state operation → mocked response. The tree and README support the broad service coverage; sampled code also confirms Step Functions execution and event-history behavior. Some service wiring is represented at the package-layer level because those implementations were not sampled.
